GAAP operating loss: $(44,373)  
+ Stock-based compensation: $750,671  
+ Amortization of acquired intangibles: $6,373  
+ Employer payroll taxes on employee stock transactions: $53,799  
+ M&A transaction costs: $1,574  

All figures are disclosed in the “RECONCILIATION OF GAAP TO NON-GAAP OPERATING INCOME (LOSS) (in thousands), Year Ended December 31, 2025” table in Datadog’s FY 2025 earnings release. [DOC: datadog_8k_fy2025.txt]

Summing these amounts (all in thousands) yields:

-44,373 + 750,671 + 6,373 + 53,799 + 1,574 = 768,044 (in thousands), i.e. $768.0 million of non-GAAP operating income for 2025. [DOC: datadog_8k_fy2025.txt]

ANSWER: $768.0 million
